Label.Tooltip: What the Gossip Stones say. No Hints: their normal rumors. Balanced: a mix of clues: areas on the Way of the Hero (holding something you can't finish without), areas that are a waste of time, where some major items are, and what some locations hold. Strong: more Way of the Hero and waste-of-time clues, fewer item clues, no joke lines. Useless: every stone tells a joke. A clue that names a location is only put on a stone you can read without that location's item. Hints are listed in the spoiler log.

Label.Tooltip: Mask of Truth Required: as in the original game, a stone only speaks to child Link wearing the Mask of Truth; otherwise Navi comments on it. Hints then never name something you need to get the mask. No Mask of Truth: every stone speaks to anyone, at any age, with or without the mask.
